scope: Independent visual inspection of all three exact anonymous Hosting preview installer screenshots; no hosted interactions or source edits by this reviewer.

screenshots.label: english
screenshots.notes: All English text is readable; the brand and language selector, Open in browser control, expanded iPhone/Android steps, account guidance, full QR, copy/PDF/image controls and preservation guidance are present without overlap or horizontal page overflow.

screenshots.label: chinese
screenshots.notes: Chinese headings, instructions and controls render clearly with complete glyphs and suitable line wrapping. The phone instructions, account guidance, full QR, copy/download actions and existing-app preservation guidance remain visible without overlap.

screenshots.label: offline
screenshots.notes: Cold-offline English capture is visually complete and byte-identical to the online English image. Brand and QR render, instructions and all displayed controls remain present.

limitations: The screenshots are full-page captures from a 390 by 844 browser viewport; they do not certify physical iPhone or Android installation, native menus, camera QR scanning, or phone capacity.

The long canonical URL is contained in its text field; copy/QR/PDF actions are visible. Functional installer, asset parity and cold-offline checks belong to the installer proof and were not rerun by this visual review.
This preview review is a release check, not a record of production promotion.
